apps.name: Idle RPG
apps.subtitle: Idle progression, powered by your Steam inventory.
apps.localizedDescription:
Idle RPG + Steam Market.

Manage your character's idle combat, track your Steam inventory, and collect rare loot — all without lifting a finger.

This is an early preview (F7) showing the Login, Dashboard, Inventory and Widget screens.

versions.localizedDescription: Early F7 preview: Login, Dashboard (Winning/Danger/Stuck/Rewards Ready states), Inventory grid with rarity colours, and Android widget mockup.
